title: Matn 1: Praise, Salah on the Prophet and Why We Learn Creed Young
description: You will know how the manẓūmah begins and why creed is learned young.
objectives: {"Say the opening praise and salah on the Prophet ﷺ","Explain why we memorise creed in childhood","Recite the opening part from memory"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 1: Imam ash-Shāfiʿī — Patience When Days Turn
description: You will recite three verses of Imam ash-Shāfiʿī on patience and good character.
objectives: {"Recite the three verses","Find the command verbs","Explain the lesson on patience"}

title: Matn 2: Where Our Belief Comes From
description: You will name the sources of belief and why we follow the Companions’ understanding.
objectives: {"Name the Qur’an and Sunnah as sources","Say why we follow the first generations","Recite this part from memory"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 2: Imam ash-Shāfiʿī — The Fault Is in Us
description: You will recite two verses on looking at our own faults first.
objectives: {"Recite both verses","Find words ending with ـنَا","Explain the lesson in your own words"}

title: Matn 3: Who Is Your Lord?
description: You will say who your Lord is and give three signs from daily life.
objectives: {"Answer مَنْ رَبُّكَ؟","Say Allah creates, provides and controls","Recite this part from memory"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 3: The Six Keys to Knowledge
description: You will recite two verses on the six things needed to gain knowledge.
objectives: {"Recite both verses","Name the six keys","Use لَنْ + present verb"}

title: Matn 4: The Three Kinds of Tawhid
description: You will name the three kinds of Tawhid.
objectives: {"Name the three kinds","Explain each in one sentence","Recite this part from memory"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 4: Abū al-ʿAtāhiyah — This World Is Temporary
description: You will recite a verse reminding us that this world is temporary.
objectives: {"Recite the verse","Spot group commands ending with ـوا","Say how it changes what we do"}

title: Matn 5: Worship and Its Two Conditions
description: You will know that worship is for Allah alone and its two conditions.
objectives: {"Name sincerity and following the Prophet ﷺ","Give three acts of worship","Recite this part from memory"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 5: Zuhayr ibn Abī Sulmā — Character Always Shows
description: You will recite two wise verses by Zuhayr ibn Abī Sulmā.
objectives: {"Recite both verses","Use مَهْمَا with your teacher","Explain why character shows"}

title: Matn 6: Our Duties to the Prophet ﷺ, His Family and the Companions
description: You will name our duties to the Prophet ﷺ, his family and the Companions.
objectives: {"Name the four duties","Say who else we love and why","Recite the closing du‘ā’"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 6: Imruʾ al-Qays — The Power of Words
description: You will recite two famous verses by Imruʾ al-Qays and notice vivid imagery.
objectives: {"Recite both verses","Explain the picture of the horse","Know that كَ means like"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 7: Ḥassān ibn Thābit — Praising the Prophet ﷺ
description: You will recite two verses by Ḥassān ibn Thābit praising the Prophet ﷺ.
objectives: {"Recite both verses","Use أَفْعَلُ مِنْ to compare","Use لَمْ + present verb"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 8: Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr — Repentance and the Light of the Prophet ﷺ
description: You will recite two verses from Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr and retell his story.
objectives: {"Recite both verses","Use إِنَّ correctly","Retell Kaʿb’s repentance"}

title: Mahfūdhāt 9: Al-Mutanabbī — Big Goals, Big Hearts
description: You will recite two famous verses by al-Mutanabbī and learn broken plurals.
objectives: {"Recite both verses","Name three broken plurals","Set one high goal"}
